from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """One judgment document with its case cause information."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The document's title/identifier (e.g. '判决文书4')")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="The case type: criminal (刑事), civil (民事), administrative (行政), etc.")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The specific charge or case cause (e.g. '组织、领导传销活动罪', '虚开增值税专用发票罪')")
    category_classification: str | None = Field(description="The crime category if criminal, e.g. '破坏社会主义市场经济秩序罪', or 'civil case', 'administrative case'")
    match_criteria: bool | None = Field(description="Whether this document matches the task criteria (criminal case under 破坏社会主义市场经济秩序罪)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgment_documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
